entries.ef5ca90ae93fee9a: A holding company with its head office in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, which forms a group with six consolidated subsidiaries. It has two reportable segments, Solutions and Content; revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥22,858 million, and consolidated employees numbered 351. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
